accounting.cost_unit: simulator operations; tool_steps and cost_units logged separately; no currency or token claim
accounting.initializer_cost_allocation: RSI reuses its initializer's computed selection; actual shared computation is logged once, each final artifact is separately built
accounting.source_cost_allocation: shared offline dataset charged once globally, not zeroed or duplicated per method

limitations: Finite-state actor and a shared synthetic world; family names do not establish real domain transfer.
Fault categories are explicit public contracts; public_contract_rule is a strong hand-written sanity control.
Greedy and beam RSI search a fixed four-mechanism vocabulary, not unrestricted generated agent code.
all_compatible means maximum compatible cardinality capped at two, using preregistered mechanism order.
Endpoint and scalar controls are simplified research baselines, not reproductions of MetaSkills, JIT, or SHIFT.
Uncertainty penalty is a sparse-support residual heuristic, not a calibrated predictive confidence interval.
Selection utility is success minus a tool-call penalty; cost_units also counts local operations and is separately reported, not optimized directly.
Four query families and correlated synthetic cases do not establish power or justify eliminating RSI claims.
Support outcomes select RSI candidates; query outcomes only produce final evaluation and reporting.

The frozen constructor is instance-conditioned but RSI optimizes a fixed harness on heterogeneous family support. Its degradation can reflect support/query profile mismatch; these four cells cannot test RSI redundancy or elimination.
A separate positive repair control uses independent dev tasks with matched public profiles to check whether beam search can discover a synergistic pair.
Support is restricted by public API capabilities; query retains interface-restricted and unseen-composition cases.
Failure-feature and interaction ablations are diagnostics; no performance win is enforced by the implementation.
